questions.question: Which loss should select the penalty in this exercise?
options: A repeatedly inspected final test loss
questions.explanation: Validation compares predictive performance of candidates fitted on training data. A separate final test set is for reporting after selection.
optionFeedback: Penalized training losses mix prediction error with a penalty and are not directly comparable evidence of held-out prediction quality.
Validation compares predictive performance of candidates fitted on training data. A separate final test set is for reporting after selection.
Repeatedly choosing settings on the test set makes it part of model selection. Use validation data, then evaluate the frozen choice on test data.
